WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as n,
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT cognitive_score, reaction_ms,
    avg_cog, avg_reaction,
    (AVG(cognitive_score) * n) - SUM(cognitive_score) as diff_cog,
    (AVG(reaction_ms) * n) - SUM(reaction_ms) as diff_reaction
FROM measurements, stats
GROUP BY session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes;

WITH percentile_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as p25_cog,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as median_cog,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as p75_cog,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as p25_react,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as median_react,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as p75_react
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT * FROM percentile_calc;

WITH ranked_cog AS (
    SELECT 
        cognitive_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as rn,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements) as n
    FROM measurements
),
cog_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score)) as p25,
        ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score)) as median,
        ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score)) as p75
    FROM ranked_cog
    WHERE rn BETWEEN 7 AND 14
),
ranked_reaction AS (
    SELECT 
        reaction_ms,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as rn,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements) as n
    FROM measurements
),
reaction_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms)) as p25_react,
        ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms)) as median_react,
        ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms)) as p75_react
    FROM ranked_reaction
    WHERE rn BETWEEN 7 AND 14
)
SELECT 
    cq.p25 as q1_cog, cq.median as med_cog, cq.p75 as q3_cog,
    rq.p25_react as q1_react, rq.median as med_react, rq.p75 as q3_react
FROM cog_quartiles cq, reaction_quartiles rq;
